headline: Official Removal Of Former Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka
seoTitle: Removal Of Official Portraits Of Gibran Rakabuming Raka
metaDescription: Official portraits of former Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka are being removed from government offices following his resignation from the position.
aiSummaryBullets: Government offices, including police facilities and regional legislative bodies in Jakarta, have begun removing official portraits of Gibran Rakabuming Raka.
Jakarta provincial authorities confirmed they consulted with the central government regarding the protocol for removing the portraits.
Historical comparisons have emerged noting that Gibran Rakabuming Raka is the second vice president in Indonesian history to resign, following Mohammad Hatta in 1956.
aiContextParagraph: Following the resignation of Gibran Rakabuming Raka as Vice President, various government institutions across Indonesia have initiated the removal of his official portraits. The process has been observed in police stations, regional government offices, and local legislative councils. In Jakarta, the provincial government confirmed that the decision to remove the images followed formal consultations with the central government. While the removal process has been systematic, it has faced minor logistical incidents, including reports of portraits being displayed incorrectly during the transition. Public interest in the shift has extended to local merchants, who have reported a decline in the demand for stock featuring the former vice president. The resignation of a sitting vice president has prompted widespread media discussion regarding historical precedents, specifically comparing this event to the resignation of former Vice President Mohammad Hatta in December 1956.
whyItIsViral: The story is trending due to high engagement across major media outlets and a significant spike in public search interest for the involved political figure.
